The first time you log in to WoW Forever, you choose an Experience Preset, Classic or Enhanced, before you pick a ruleset, and you only see that screen once. Classic starts with standard definition models, quest markers, one-bag and transmog off, keys that turn your character, and the classic UI layout. Enhanced starts with HD models, quest markers, one-bag and transmog on, and keys that strafe. Blizzard's advice: if you're not sure, start with Enhanced. Every setting can be changed later under Game Menu, then Options, and HD or SD models are chosen per character (change them in Options or at a Barbershop). Rulesets at launch: Normal, PvP, Roleplay and Roleplay PvP; Hardcore comes sometime after launch.
